title: aster occidentalis var. yosemitanus
intro: Aster occidentalis var. yosemitanus, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a variety of the Western Yarrow plant, a flowering perennial native to the western regions of North America. Western Yarrow is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The plant's therapeutic actions include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of Western Yarrow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
